from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Titles and lecture lines
        title = "The Conflict: Health vs. Privacy"
        lines = [
            'How can we track exposure without tracking people?', 
            "Traditional tracing often requires a central authority's surveillance.", 
            'DP-3T offers a privacy-first approach to proximity tracing.', 
            'Meet Alice and Bob, two privacy-conscious friends.', 
            'They want safety without sharing their locations.'
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Colors
        ALICE_COLOR = "#58D68D"
        BOB_COLOR = "#F5B041"
        SERVER_COLOR = "#EC7063"
        SHIELD_COLOR = "#5DADE2"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # How can we track exposure without tracking people?
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        
        # Initialize Alice and Bob circles (will label in line 4)
        alice_node = Circle(radius=0.5, color=ALICE_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.3)
        self.place_at_grid(alice_node, "D2")
        
        bob_node = Circle(radius=0.5, color=BOB_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.3)
        self.place_at_grid(bob_node, "D5")
        
        self.play(Create(alice_node), Create(bob_node))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Traditional tracing often requires a central authority's surveillance.
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(SERVER_COLOR))
        
        # Central Server icon
        server_rect = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, height=1, width=1.5, color=SERVER_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.5)
        server_label = Text("SERVER", font_size=16, color=WHITE)
        server_group = VGroup(server_rect, server_label)
        self.place_in_area(server_group, "A3", "A4")
        
        # Surveillance lines
        line_a = Line(alice_node.get_top(), server_group.get_bottom(), color=SERVER_COLOR, stroke_width=2)
        line_b = Line(bob_node.get_top(), server_group.get_bottom(), color=SERVER_COLOR, stroke_width=2)
        
        data_label_a = Text("Location Data", font_size=12, color=SERVER_COLOR).next_to(line_a, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        data_label_b = Text("Location Data", font_size=12, color=SERVER_COLOR).next_to(line_b, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        self.play(FadeIn(server_group))
        self.play(Create(line_a), Create(line_b))
        self.play(Write(data_label_a), Write(data_label_b))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # DP-3T offers a privacy-first approach to proximity tracing.
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(SHIELD_COLOR))
        
        # Privacy Shield
        shield = Polygon(
            [-0.5, 0.5, 0], [0.5, 0.5, 0], [0.5, -0.2, 0], [0, -0.6, 0], [-0.5, -0.2, 0],
            color=SHIELD_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.8
        )
        self.place_in_area(shield, "B3", "B4", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Blocking lines
        self.play(FadeIn(shield))
        self.play(
            FadeOut(line_a), FadeOut(line_b),
            FadeOut(data_label_a), FadeOut(data_label_b)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Meet Alice and Bob, two privacy-conscious friends.
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        
        alice_label = Text("Alice", font_size=18, color=ALICE_COLOR)
        bob_label = Text("Bob", font_size=18, color=BOB_COLOR)
        
        # Using grid-based manual placement relative to nodes for safety
        alice_label.next_to(alice_node, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        bob_label.next_to(bob_node, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Write(alice_label), Write(bob_label))
        self.play(Indicate(alice_node), Indicate(bob_node))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # They want safety without sharing their locations.
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(SHIELD_COLOR))
        
        # Symbolic "Safety" (Proximity check without data flow)
        proximity_wave = Circle(radius=1.5, color=SHIELD_COLOR, stroke_width=2).move_to(alice_node.get_center())
        proximity_wave.set_stroke(opacity=0)
        
        self.play(
            proximity_wave.animate.scale(1.5).set_stroke(opacity=0.5),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.play(FadeOut(proximity_wave))
        
        self.wait(2)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        self.setup_layout(
            "Prerequisite: The One-Way Function (Hashing)", 
            [
                'Every day, your phone generates a secret Daily Seed.', 
                'A cryptographic Hash Function transforms seeds into IDs.', 
                'These Ephemeral IDs look random and protect your seed.'
            ]
        )
        
        # Define Colors
        COLOR_SEED = "#5DADE2"
        COLOR_HASH = "#F4D336"
        COLOR_EPHID = "#58D68D"
        COLOR_WALL = "#EC7063"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(COLOR_SEED))
        
        # Create Daily Seed
        seed_rect = Rectangle(width=1.5, height=0.8, color=COLOR_SEED, fill_opacity=0.3)
        seed_text = Text("Daily Seed", font_size=18, color=COLOR_SEED)
        seed_group = VGroup(seed_rect, seed_text)
        self.place_at_grid(seed_group, "C1")
        
        # Create Hash Box (initially just defined, shown in next step)
        hash_box = Rectangle(width=2, height=2, color=COLOR_HASH, fill_opacity=0.2)
        hash_label = Text("Hash\nFunction", font_size=20, color=COLOR_HASH)
        hash_group = VGroup(hash_box, hash_label)
        self.place_in_area(hash_group, "B3", "D4")
        
        self.play(FadeIn(seed_group))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Move Seed to Hash Box
        self.play(seed_group.animate.move_to(hash_group.get_center()), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(seed_group), FadeIn(hash_group))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_HASH))
        
        # Create Ephemeral IDs
        ephid_positions = ["B6", "C6", "D6"]
        ephids = VGroup()
        for i, pos in enumerate(ephid_positions):
            e_text = Text(f"EphID_{i+1}", font_size=18, color=COLOR_EPHID)
            e_box = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, width=1.2, height=0.5, color=COLOR_EPHID)
            e_group = VGroup(e_box, e_text)
            self.place_at_grid(e_group, pos)
            ephids.add(e_group)

        # Animate EphIDs emerging from Hash Box
        spawn_animations = []
        for ephid in ephids:
            # Start from center of hash box
            target_pos = ephid.get_center().copy()
            ephid.move_to(hash_group.get_center())
            spawn_animations.append(ephid.animate.move_to(target_pos))
        
        self.play(AnimationGroup(*spawn_animations, lag_ratio=0.3))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_EPHID))
        
        # Create One-Way Wall
        wall = Line(self.grid["A2"], self.grid["F2"], color=COLOR_WALL, stroke_width=8)
        wall_label = Text("One-Way Wall", font_size=16, color=COLOR_WALL).next_to(wall, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(Create(wall), FadeIn(wall_label))
        
        # Create Back Arrow
        start_point = ephids[1].get_left()
        end_point = self.grid["C1"]
        back_arrow = Arrow(start_point, end_point, color=COLOR_WALL, buff=0)
        
        # Animate back arrow hitting the wall
        # Intersection with wall is at column 2 (approx)
        collision_point = [self.grid["C2"][0], self.grid["C2"][1], 0]
        
        self.play(back_arrow.animate.put_start_and_end_on(start_point, collision_point), run_time=1)
        
        # Visual feedback for hitting the wall
        flash = Flash(collision_point, color=COLOR_WALL, flash_radius=0.3)
        self.play(flash)
        
        # Rebound slightly or stop
        self.play(back_arrow.animate.shift(RIGHT * 0.2), run_time=0.5)
        
        self.wait(2)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "Phase 1: The Digital Whisper (Broadcast)"
        lines = [
            "Alice's phone broadcasts a random ID every few minutes.",
            'Bob\'s phone listens and records these nearby "whispers."',
            'This exchange happens locally using Bluetooth Low Energy.',
            'No names or locations are shared during whispers.',
            'Devices just exchange anonymous, temporary codes.'
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)
        
        # Colors
        ALICE_COLOR = "#58D68D"
        BOB_COLOR = "#F5B041"
        PULSE_COLOR = "#5DADE2"
        
        # Mobjects
        # Alice Phone
        alice_phone = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, height=1.4, width=0.8, color=ALICE_COLOR)
        alice_label = Text("Alice", font_size=20, color=ALICE_COLOR)
        alice_group = VGroup(alice_phone, alice_label).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(alice_group, "B2")
        
        # Bob Phone
        bob_phone = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, height=1.4, width=0.8, color=BOB_COLOR)
        bob_label = Text("Bob", font_size=20, color=BOB_COLOR)
        bob_group = VGroup(bob_phone, bob_label).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(bob_group, "B5")
        
        # Visitor Log
        log_rect = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.05, height=1.6, width=2.2, color=WHITE)
        log_title = Text("Visitor Log", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        log_vgroup = VGroup(log_title, log_rect).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(log_vgroup, "E5")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(ALICE_COLOR)
        self.play(FadeIn(alice_group), FadeIn(bob_group))
        
        # Pulse XJ-9
        p1_circ = Circle(radius=0.4, color=PULSE_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.3)
        p1_text = Text("XJ-9", font_size=16, color=WHITE)
        p1 = VGroup(p1_circ, p1_text)
        self.place_at_grid(p1, "B2")
        
        self.play(p1.animate.scale(1.2), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(BOB_COLOR)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(log_vgroup))
        self.play(p1.animate.move_to(self.grid["B5"]), run_time=1.2)
        
        entry1 = Text("XJ-9", font_size=16, color=PULSE_COLOR)
        entry1.move_to(log_rect.get_center() + UP * 0.4)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(p1), FadeIn(entry1))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(PULSE_COLOR)
        
        ble_text = Text("Bluetooth Low Energy", font_size=18, color=PULSE_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(ble_text, "A3")
        
        # Propagation effect
        prop = Circle(radius=0.1, color=PULSE_COLOR, stroke_width=2).move_to(self.grid["B2"])
        self.play(Write(ble_text))
        self.play(prop.animate.scale(15).set_stroke(opacity=0), run_time=1.5)
        self.remove(prop)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(RED)
        
        privacy_vgroup = VGroup(
            Text("Name: Alice", font_size=16),
            Text("Location: (40.7, -74.0)", font_size=16)
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(privacy_vgroup, "D2")
        
        cross = Cross(privacy_vgroup, color=RED, stroke_width=4)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(privacy_vgroup))
        self.play(Create(cross))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(PULSE_COLOR)
        
        # Pulse QK-4
        p2_circ = Circle(radius=0.4, color=PULSE_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.3)
        p2_text = Text("QK-4", font_size=16, color=WHITE)
        p2 = VGroup(p2_circ, p2_text)
        self.place_at_grid(p2, "B2")
        
        entry2 = Text("QK-4", font_size=16, color=PULSE_COLOR)
        entry2.next_to(entry1, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(p2))
        self.play(p2.animate.move_to(self.grid["B5"]), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeOut(p2), FadeIn(entry2))
        self.wait(2)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        title = "Phase 2: The Local Diary (Storage)"
        lines = [
            "Bob's phone keeps a private log of IDs heard.",
            'This "Local Diary" stays only on his device.',
            'Without secret seeds, these IDs are just gibberish.'
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Bob's Phone Container
        phone_frame = RoundedRectangle(height=4.5, width=2.5, corner_radius=0.3, color="#AED6F1")
        self.place_in_area(phone_frame, "B1", "E3")
        
        # Local Log Header
        log_title = Text("Local Log", font_size=20, color="#AED6F1")
        self.place_at_grid(log_title, "B2")
        
        # Table content
        row1 = Text("ID: XJ-9", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        row2 = Text("ID: PL-2", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        row3 = Text("ID: TR-7", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        
        self.place_at_grid(row1, "C2")
        self.place_at_grid(row2, "D2")
        self.place_at_grid(row3, "E2")
        
        log_content = VGroup(log_title, row1, row2, row3)
        
        self.play(Create(phone_frame))
        self.play(Write(log_content))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Metadata labels that are NOT included
        gps_label = Text("GPS Data", font_size=20, color="#EC7063")
        name_label = Text("Name/Identity", font_size=20, color="#EC7063")
        
        self.place_at_grid(gps_label, "B5")
        self.place_at_grid(name_label, "C5")
        
        # Red X marks
        cross1 = VGroup(
            Line(UP+LEFT, DOWN+RIGHT, color="#EC7063"),
            Line(UP+RIGHT, DOWN+LEFT, color="#EC7063")
        ).scale(0.3).move_to(gps_label.get_center())
        
        cross2 = VGroup(
            Line(UP+LEFT, DOWN+RIGHT, color="#EC7063"),
            Line(UP+RIGHT, DOWN+LEFT, color="#EC7063")
        ).scale(0.3).move_to(name_label.get_center())
        
        self.play(Write(gps_label), Write(name_label))
        self.play(Create(cross1), Create(cross2))
        
        # Local glow
        glow_rect = SurroundingRectangle(phone_frame, color="#58D68D", buff=0.1)
        self.play(Create(glow_rect))
        self.play(Indicate(phone_frame, color="#58D68D"))

        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)

        ids_group = VGroup(row1, row2, row3)
        self.play(ids_group.animate.set_color("#F7DC6F"))
        
        # Visualizing gibberish aspect - strings briefly flicker or shift
        self.play(
            Indicate(row1, scale_factor=1.1),
            Indicate(row2, scale_factor=1.1),
            Indicate(row3, scale_factor=1.1),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Final cleanup/state
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.wait(1)

outline.topic: DP-3T: The Privacy-Preserving Digital Secret Handshake
outline.target_audience: University students (Computer Science/Data Privacy) or tech-savvy general audience

sections.title: The Conflict: Health vs. Privacy
sections.content: Introduce the challenge of contact tracing: How can we identify people who were near a sick person without a central government tracking everyone's location 24/7? Introduce the DP-3T (Decentralized Privacy-Preserving Proximity Tracing) as the 'Privacy-First' solution.
sections.example: Imagine two squirrels, Alice and Bob. They want to know if they've shared the same tree, but they don't want a 'Grand Owl' keeping a master list of everywhere they go.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The One-Way Function (Hashing)
sections.content: Explain the concept of a 'Hash' and a 'Daily Seed.' A Daily Seed is a secret key that changes every 24 hours. From this seed, we can generate many unique, random-looking 'Ephemeral IDs' (EphIDs) that cannot be traced back to the seed easily.
sections.example: Visual: A 'Magic Box' (Hash function). You put a 'Blue Seed' in, and it spits out 100 different 'Unique Marble Patterns' (EphIDs). You can't guess the seed just by looking at the marbles.

sections.title: Phase 1: The Digital Whisper (Broadcast)
sections.content: Explain how devices interact via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Every few minutes, Alice’s phone generates a new EphID from her daily seed and broadcasts it. Bob’s phone does the same. They 'whisper' these random codes to anyone nearby.
sections.example: Alice’s phone shouts 'XJ-9' at 10:00 AM and 'QK-4' at 10:15 AM. Bob’s phone hears these and stores them in a local 'Visitor Log' on his device only.

sections.title: Phase 2: The Local Diary (Storage)
sections.content: Emphasize decentralization. Alice’s phone keeps a log of the codes *she* sent. Bob’s phone keeps a log of the codes *he* heard. Crucially, no GPS data or names are attached—just the random codes and the signal strength (distance).
sections.example: Graph visual: A timeline showing Bob's phone memory filling up with a list of random strings like [XJ-9, PL-2, TR-7], which are just gibberish to anyone else.

sections.title: Phase 3: The Positive Report (Upload)
sections.content: If Alice tests positive for a virus, she voluntarily uploads only her 'Daily Seeds' from the last 14 days to a central server. She does NOT upload her contact list. The server now has a list of 'Sick Seeds' but doesn't know who Alice is or who she met.
sections.example: Alice sends a 'Red Folder' containing her 14 Daily Seeds to a public bulletin board. The board doesn't know Alice's name, just that 'The owner of these seeds is sick'.

sections.title: Phase 4: The Private Matching (Risk Calculation)
sections.content: Every day, Bob’s phone downloads the new 'Sick Seeds' from the server. Locally, Bob’s phone uses the 'Magic Box' (Hash function) to turn those seeds into the EphIDs they would have produced. It then compares these to the 'Visitor Log' in its own memory.
sections.example: Bob's phone sees a Sick Seed, runs it through the hash, and realizes it produces 'XJ-9'. It checks its log: 'Wait, I heard XJ-9 yesterday!' Bob gets a notification to get tested, but the server never knew Bob was involved.

sections.title: Summary: Security through Math
sections.content: Review the flow: 1. Generate local IDs. 2. Whisper IDs to neighbors. 3. Upload seeds if sick. 4. Check matches locally. Highlight that privacy is maintained because the 'Central Owl' never sees the contact events.
sections.example: Visual recap: A shield forming over Alice and Bob’s phones, showing that while information flowed to keep them safe, their identities and locations stayed behind the shield.

storyboard.title: Phase 3: The Positive Report (Upload)
lecture_lines: If Alice tests positive, she voluntarily shares her seeds.
She only uploads her seeds for the infection period.
The server receives seeds, but never Alice's identity.
This public list contains sick seeds, not contact logs.
Alice's local contact list remains protected and private.
animations: Alice's phone [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/phone.svg] icon turns Red (#EC7063) with a 'Positive' label.
14 small Seed icons (#5DADE2) are extracted and labeled 'Infectious Seeds'.
The group of Seeds moves into a Cloud [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cloud.svg] icon labeled 'Backend Server' (#F4D336).
The Cloud [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cloud.svg] displays a public list of the 14 Seeds with no personal names.
Show a 'Shield' (#58D68D) remaining over Alice's local contact list.

storyboard.title: Phase 4: The Private Matching (Risk Calculation)
lecture_lines: Bob's phone periodically downloads the new public sick seeds.
His phone locally generates IDs from these seeds.
It compares these generated IDs to his visitor log.
A match indicates Bob was near a sick person.
Bob receives a private notification to get tested.
animations: Bob's phone pulls the list of Seeds (#5DADE2) from the Cloud icon.
Inside Bob's phone, the Seeds pass through the 'Hash Box' (#F4D336).
A list of generated EphIDs appears next to Bob's 'Visitor Log'.
One matching ID 'XJ-9' in the log turns Red (#EC7063) and flashes.
A 'Notification' box with text 'Potential Exposure' pops up on Bob's phone.

storyboard.title: Summary: Security through Math
lecture_lines: The DP-3T protocol loops through broadcast, log, and match.
A privacy shield protects the entire decentralized process.
DP-3T ensures our safety and privacy coexist through math.
animations: Show icons for 'Broadcast', 'Log', 'Upload', 'Match' around a smartphone [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg] in a circular flow.
A large green 'Privacy Shield' [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/shield.svg] (#58D68D) expands to cover all icons.
Display final text 'DP-3T: Decentralized, Private, Safe' (#FDFEFE) in center.
